documents.label: Manager (Engineering) 04/OG/HM/2026 original guide
documents.jobSummary: Manager (Engineering), HMWSSB, 130 provisional vacancies, Multi Zone-II. Engineering branches: civil; electrical/mechanical; CSE/IT/ECE.
documents.nationalitySummary: Section 2, printed page 3: Indian citizenship required. Applies only to this notice; not an authority-wide rule.
documents.qualificationSummary: Qualification result declared by notice date 18 September; age 18–44 as at 1 July before applicable relaxations.
documents.residenceSummary: Section 5: 95% local reservation with study/residence evidence; page 5: other-state applicants not entitled to reservations. Unreserved does not mean foreign citizens permitted.
documents.languageSummary: Annexure II, printed page 15: Paper I English/Telugu; Paper II English; Basic English at 10th-class standard. No CEFR/JLPT/IELTS-equivalent or named proficiency certificate established.
documents.selectionSummary: Section 12, printed page 10: objective examination, merit, document verification; minimum marks do not guarantee selection. Appointment conditions separate.

documents.label: Manager recruitment brief web note
documents.observation: Same notice and 130 vacancies; date-only application range agrees with original. This is supporting evidence for same cycle, not another cycle.

documents.label: Syllabus-change clarification
documents.observation: Commission says no syllabus committee constituted; major proposed changes would be notified one year ahead, minor changes accompany respective notifications. Title alone does not establish changed Manager syllabus.
